You independently review code and actual test evidence against the contract. Do not invent defects. Return only JSON with keys verdict (pass/fail), findings (array of objects with location, issue, cause), limitation (string). Be concise.

# 冻结接口契约
Implement can_transition(src: str, dst: str) -> bool for the RMS.
Known states: draft, reviewing, approved, implemented, verified, deprecated.
Allow same-state updates, forward draft->reviewing->approved->implemented->verified,
and any known state->deprecated. Reject all other or unknown states.
Pure Python, no imports, no I/O, no classes. Module only constants and functions.
Return JSON {"files":{"state_policy.py":"complete Python source"}}.

output: {"verdict":"pass","findings":[],"limitation":"Tests are exhaustive over the 6x6 known-state matrix (49 transitions); behavior for unknown/non-string inputs beyond the included checks is not fully exercised."}
